Developed by GamePix, this game is an excellent example of how a simple concept can be transformed into an addictive experience. In WindMill, your objective is to collect bags of different colors and guide them into their respective mills. Sounds easy, right? But as you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, requiring you to think quickly and make split-second decisions to avoid collisions and maximize your rewards.

The game features colorful graphics and an upbeat soundtrack that will keep you engaged and motivated. sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, WindMill is a game about timing and spatial reasoning. Your mission is to collect bags of different colors and guide them into their respective mills. The game features four mills: green, red, blue, and yellow. Each mill is associated with a specific color, and you'll need to collect bags of that color to fill the mill. The twist is that you can't just dump the bags into the mill - you'll need to time your movements perfectly to avoid collisions with other bags or the mill itself.

The gameplay is deceptively simple, but it requires a great deal of skill and strategy to master. You'll need to anticipate the movement of the bags, plan your routes carefully, and make split-second decisions to avoid obstacles. As you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, with faster-moving bags, obstacles, and time limits.

One of the key mechanics in WindMill is the mill itself. You can turn the mill to the left or right using the buttons on the left and right sides of the screen. This allows you to adjust the mill's position to avoid collisions or create space for new bags. The mill also has a limited capacity, so you'll need to time your collections carefully to avoid overflowing the mill.
